fields.name: Dummy
fields.evidence: The component is stored behind a pointer (8 bytes inline): creator bg3.exe+0x1A2C8C0 allocates 0x148 bytes and writes the null handle constant DAT_146174970 at +0. bg3.exe+0x1A2BB60 (attaches a thrown object to the thrower's visual) writes local_d8 here - the entity resolved by bg3.exe+0x1A29580 for the thrown object, whose ls::Visual is attached with ls::Visual::AddAttachment to the visual of the component's owner (the thrower).

fields.name: Effect
fields.evidence: Opaque 304 bytes (0x130) holding an ecl::EffectHandler: Script Extender's own ecl::EffectHandler (GameDefinitions/Effect.h) is 304 bytes too, but a foreign SE type cannot be used in the generated header, so the member is opaque here. Creator calls bg3.exe+0x1C73C90 on +0x8: it installs the virtual table bg3.exe+0x566C6C8, which ecl::EffectHandler::~EffectHandler (bg3.exe+0x1C73D50) also installs - the constructor of ecl::EffectHandler. Its body matches Script Extender's ecl::EffectHandler (GameDefinitions/Effect.h) member by member: VMT, three pointers, EffectHandlerInitInfo at +0x20 (bg3.exe+0x1B6E840: two null handles, two {handle, vec3, Array, flags} groups, Array, string with capacity 0xF, FixedString -1, float 1.0), Scene pointer at +0xC8, null handle at +0xD0, a nested object with its own virtual table bg3.exe+0x5529DB0 at +0xD8 (MultiEffectInfo), byte at +0x118, Array at +0x120. The constructor writes up to +0x130, so the member occupies component +0x8..+0x138. bg3.exe+0x1A2BB60 passes {Dummy, pointer to this member, a FixedString} to bg3.exe+0x1A2C2A0 when an effect is requested.

fields.name: ThrownEntity
fields.evidence: Creator: null handle constant at +0x138. bg3.exe+0x1A2BB60 writes param_5 here - the thrown item or character (the function reads its ecl::Item / ecl::Character template bounds to centre the attachment). bg3.exe+0x1A2A790 checks this handle with IsEntityAlive for every component.

fields.name: field_140
fields.evidence: Creator: 0. bg3.exe+0x1A2BB60 copies the byte at +8 of the owner's eoc::thrown::AttachComponent (bg3.exe+0xAF8730) when it has one; that component is not declared in Script Extender, the meaning of the byte is unknown.

fields.name: _Pad141
fields.evidence: padding to the end of the 0x148-byte allocation

fields.name: field_148
fields.evidence: Not part of the object: the component slot holds a pointer (creator bg3.exe+0x1A2C8C0: ComponentFrameStorageAllocRaw(storage, 8) stores the pointer returned by a 0x148-byte allocation), so the registry size 336 is the object size 0x148 + 8.
